ai_tools.card.chatgpt.desc: The most widely used assistant offering general purpose chat, text, code and image production (integrated into DALL·E). The most balanced option for daily use.
ai_tools.card.claude.desc: It excels in long text analysis, software development and meticulous writing. Strong in interpreting large files/code bases.
ai_tools.card.gemini.desc: Deep integration with Google search, Docs, Gmail and Android. Powerful for accessing current information and research.
ai_tools.card.perplexity.desc: Citing "AI search engine". Ideal for current events and research requiring verifiable information.
ai_tools.card.copilot.desc: Integrated with Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Windows. Practical for office documents and workflows.
ai_tools.card.grok.desc: It stands out in current events and social media trend analysis thanks to its real-time access to X (Twitter) data.
ai_tools.card.deepseek.desc: It offers very low-cost open models that are powerful in coding and mathematics. It is one of the options with the highest price/performance ratio.
ai_tools.card.deepseek.price: Web is free · API is very low cost
ai_tools.card.midjourney.desc: Industry standard in visual/image production; The highest quality in artistic and photorealistic visuals.
ai_tools.card.suno.desc: Generates full song (lyrics + music) from text. A fast and practical option in music/jingle production.
ai_tools.card.meta.desc: It comes embedded in WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook. Completely free, practical for daily chat and visual production.
ai_tools.card.lechat.desc: Europe-based, privacy-focused general-purpose assistant. Strong in multilingualism and fast response times.
ai_tools.card.ghcopilot.desc: Line-by-line code completion and chat assistant within the IDE. It integrates directly into the daily workflow of software developers.
ai_tools.card.cursor.desc: Artificial intelligence-supported code editor designed from scratch. Powerful for code generation and refactor across the entire project.
ai_tools.card.elevenlabs.desc: Industry leader in realistic text-to-speech (TTS) and voice cloning. It is preferred in voice-over, dubbing and podcast production.
ai_tools.card.runway.desc: One of the leading tools that produces video from text or images. Used for AI video effects in film/advertising production.
ai_tools.card.leonardo.desc: Alternative to Midjourney in visual production; stands out for its gameplay/character design and consistent style patterns.
ai_tools.card.notion.desc: Notion is a writing, summarizing and task management assistant built into your workspace. Practical for note/document heavy teams.
ai_tools.card.characterai.desc: Role-play and chat experience with personalized characters. Preferred for entertainment, storytelling and creative writing.
ai_tools.card.poe.desc: An aggregator platform that provides access to many models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini from a single interface. Practical for those who want to compare models.

mk_dashboard.heading: MikroTik RouterOS Configuration Panel
mk_dashboard.intro: Use the native and mathematical toolbox to optimize your network, create firewall rules and generate automation scripts. Without any AI connection, all calculations are done securely in your browser.
mk_dashboard.warning: All tools and scripts in this panel are helpful/example; Take a backup before applying and use at your own risk.
mk_dashboard.item_subnet_desc: Calculate CIDR, IP ranges and number of hosts locally mathematically.
mk_dashboard.item_ipguide_desc: Technical guidance on class A, B, C IP blocks and subnet masks.
mk_dashboard.item_dhcp_desc: DHCP Pool, Server and Network commands for devices to automatically obtain IP.
mk_dashboard.item_iface_desc: IP assignment wizard to physical and virtual ports (LAN, WAN, Bridge).
mk_dashboard.item_portfwd_desc: Rules for redirecting requests from the external network to your local servers (RDP, Web, etc.).
mk_dashboard.item_srcnat_desc: NAT configuration to safely open devices on the local network to the outside world.
mk_dashboard.item_routing_desc: Routing tables for different gateways and backup lines (Failover).
mk_dashboard.item_lb_desc: Combining multiple WAN (Internet) lines and sharing the load.
mk_dashboard.item_firewall_desc: DDoS protection, crawl blocking, and general RouterOS filter rules.
mk_dashboard.item_dns_desc: Blocking advertising, malware and telemetry domains at the router level.
mk_dashboard.item_ports_desc: Turning off or changing default management ports such as Winbox, Webfig, SSH.
mk_dashboard.item_vpn_desc: Creating high-speed, encrypted VPN tunnels available with RouterOS v7.
mk_dashboard.item_netwatch_desc: Scripts that send automatic e-mail or telegram notifications when the target IP is interrupted.
mk_dashboard.item_log_desc: Monitoring critical system logs and SMTP/Telegram integration timers.
mk_dashboard.item_pcq_desc: Rules for dynamically and fairly sharing internet speed between users.
mk_dashboard.item_fasttrack_desc: Enabling data packets to be routed much faster by reducing processor load.
mk_dashboard.item_wifi_desc: Optimal channel and frequency selection to avoid conflicts in wireless networks.
mk_dashboard.howto_body: To apply the configuration codes generated by the tools to your router, simply open New Terminal from Winbox and paste it. For more detailed instructions, you can review the User Guide.

mk_guide.title: How to Use?
mk_guide.heading: User Guide & Help
mk_guide.intro: Learn step by step how to use the produced MikroTik scripts and the tools on the website.
mk_guide.warning: This guide is for general information purposes only; Apply scripts and commands at your own risk, taking a backup.
mk_guide.section1_body: All MikroTik tools on this site (Subnet, Firewall, Port Forwarding, etc.) generate RouterOS terminal commands (scripts) for you. The easiest way to apply these scripts to your device is to use Winbox Terminal.
mk_guide.step1_body: Go to the page of the vehicle you want to create, fill in the required fields and click the "Copy" button above the generated script on the right.
mk_guide.step2_body: To connect to your MikroTik router, open the Winbox application on your computer and log in with your device's IP address or MAC address.
mk_guide.step3_body: Open the MikroTik command line interface (CLI) by clicking the "New Terminal" button in the Winbox left menu.
mk_guide.step4_label: STEP 4: Paste the Code and Run
mk_guide.step4_body: Right-click on an empty space on the black terminal screen that opens and click "Paste". Commands will be processed automatically line by line.
mk_guide.security_item1: Take a Backup: Before running any script, make sure to backup your router from Files -> Backup.
mk_guide.security_item2: Interface Names: Make sure that the interface names in the scripts (eg: ether1, bridge) match the names on your own router.
mk_guide.security_item3: Firewall: When applying firewall scripts, be careful not to block your own administrator IP address or connection.
mk_guide.pdf_item1: Go to PDF Tools on the home page or open PDF Joiner directly.
mk_guide.pdf_item2: Select at least two PDF files you want to combine by clicking the "Select File" button.
mk_guide.pdf_item3: After selecting the files, click the "Merge PDF Files" button.
mk_guide.pdf_item4: Your merged PDF file will automatically download to your computer.
mk_guide.ai_body: The AI Assistant section is designed to answer your specific questions about MikroTik RouterOS and produce command blocks specific to your needs. Specifying your RouterOS version (v6 or v7) when asking questions will help you get more accurate commands.
